title: Web Application Security Testing Methodology
learning_outcomes: Explain the main risks and boundaries covered by Web Application Security Testing Methodology.
Choose defensive controls appropriate to the Web Application Security Testing Methodology topics and document relevant assumptions.
Create or interpret evidence that verifies secure and denied/failure behavior in a controlled environment.

notes: Preserves 9 main lesson(s) from the source PDF. Apply least privilege and default-deny authorization on the server for each relevant action, object, and property, then test both allowed and denied cases. Use authorized local labs and synthetic data only.
